**Model and settings:** (e.g. hae-s-ir int8, preset balanced, scale 1.5, tiling off)

**Camera and flight:** (thermal camera model and resolution, altitude above ground, gimbal angle, time of day, weather)

**What happened:** (people missed / false alarms on what objects; how many frames)

**Frames:** (attach 2–5 frames if you are allowed to share them; do not upload footage of identifiable people without consent — use the private channel in SECURITY.md instead)

**Version:** (`pip show hae`)
